notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dExtAnmTexSRT_c entry, the sibling class that took the same route.

dExtAnmTexPat_c is the Animation child that plays a BTP_File against ModelComponents: Update forwards the fixed-point cursor; SetFile swaps the file and re-arms the base animation through dExtFrameCtrl_c::SetAnimation; Prepare is a static long-call veneer over func_02046d50. LoadFile (0x020178e4) and UpdateFileOffsets (0x020468a0) sit in other TUs' runs and stay their own shards.

The whole class folds, lifecycle variants included: the cartridge's D0,D1,C1 order is the order one ~dExtAnmTexPat_c() plus one dExtAnmTexPat_c() emits under deferred codegen (the emitted D2 and C2 siblings have no cartridge home and deadstrip unenrolled), so no per-variant shards remain.

SetFile stays a mangled extern "C" definition (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): the Fix12<int> by-value parameter keeps the free spelling, and its call to dExtFrameCtrl_c::SetAnimation keeps the mangled spelling too because passing the real declaration's Fix12<int> by value homes the argument to the caller's stack. SetFlags, by contrast, takes a plain int and is spelled as the member call it is.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the six functions ascending 0x0201597c..0x02015a7c.

RTTI is off: this TU compiles with #pragma RTTI off. It was turned off while the class carried a coined name whose _ZTS/_ZTI records had no configured ROM home. Under the cartridge spelling they would have one (_ZTI15dExtAnmTexPat_c at 0x0208e758, _ZTS15dExtAnmTexPat_c at 0x0208e824, base _ZTI15dExtFrameCtrl_c at 0x0208e744), so RTTI on is open as a follow-up. Off, no RTTI records are emitted, and the vtable preamble's typeinfo word deadstrips with the rest of the .data output.
